summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing of LightStudy. Backend: created pytest suite (37 tests) covering auth/cookies/JWT, onboarding, subjects, diagnostic full flow, study plan, practice+adaptive difficulty+mistakes lifecycle, real Claude AI tutor (chat/explain/persistence), dashboard & statistics aggregates, mock exams (12q), profile persistence, achievements, admin CRUD + RBAC 403, cross-user isolation -> 36/37 passed (only missing brute-force lockout). Frontend: drove complete UI journeys with Playwright: register -> onboarding -> 10-question diagnostic -> results -> create plan -> dashboard -> practice (adaptive badges, feedback) -> mistakes retry -> AI tutor (real non-fallback Claude answers, quick actions, conversation persistence) -> statistics -> profile persistence -> mock exam 12q + results -> admin panel (stats/users/questions create) -> student RBAC guard -> logout. No console errors, no dead buttons found. Main defects: mobile horizontal overflow on Dashboard and Tutor, diagnostic answers not counted into attempt stats, no login lockout, wildcard CORS with credentials.

minor.issue: No brute-force protection: 6+ consecutive wrong passwords all return 401, no 423/429 lockout and no failed-attempt counter (playbook requires lockout after 5 fails)

Diagnostic answers are never written to question_attempts, so after completing a 10-question diagnostic dashboard shows 'Заданий решено 0', accuracy 0% and Statistics 'Прогресс во времени' is empty — inconsistent with 'all real data' requirement
CORS_ORIGINS="*" combined with allow_credentials=True; should be explicit origin list for cookie auth (playbook requirement)

ui_bugs.issue: At 390px viewport the chat card is 631px wide -> 257px horizontal overflow; chat header, messages and the message input are cut off / require horizontal scroll
At 390px viewport the today-tasks card is 566px wide -> 192px horizontal overflow; 'Начать' buttons and 'Весь план' link sit off-screen
Question cards and their delete buttons have no data-testid, so admin delete cannot be targeted reliably
Page has zero data-testid attributes (stat cards, charts, weak-topic rows) — not testable; Dashboard uses data-testid="stat-card" but Statistics does not

issues: Recharts tooltip renders the raw English dataKey: 'mastery : 23' — UI must be fully Russian; add Tooltip formatter/name
subject_id and topic_id are free-text inputs requiring knowledge of internal IDs (placeholders 'subject_id (напр. math_prof)'); should be selects populated from /api/subjects and /api/admin/topics
No labels for the radio group choosing the correct option, no ЕГЭ-category field
Horizontal page scroll caused by grid children missing min-w-0 (grid items default min-width:auto); chips row with overflow-x-auto expands the track

action_items: Fix mobile layout overflow: add min-w-0 (and w-full) to grid children on Dashboard (div.lg:col-span-2, ls-card) and Tutor (grid lg:grid-cols-[260px,1fr] child + chat card), ensure the quick-action chips row (overflow-x-auto) has min-w-0 so it does not widen the track
Record diagnostic answers into question_attempts (or otherwise include them in dashboard tasks_completed/accuracy and statistics progress_over_time) so stats reflect diagnostic activity
Implement failed-login lockout (e.g. 5 attempts -> 423/429 with cooldown) per auth playbook
Set CORS_ORIGINS to explicit origins instead of '*' since cookies/credentials are used
Replace admin question-form subject_id/topic_id free-text inputs with selects from /api/subjects + /api/admin/topics; add data-testid to admin question cards and delete buttons
Add data-testid attributes to Statistics page cards/rows
critical_code_review_comments: routes_diagnostic.answer_diagnostic writes only into diagnostics.answers; every other answer path (practice, mock) writes question_attempts — inconsistency causes zeroed dashboard stats after a diagnostic

routes_practice.practice_answer 'correct answer' branch calls db.mistakes.update_one without upsert (correct) but the wrong-answer branch resets 'id' on every upsert $set — the mistake document id changes on each repeat, which can break client-side keys/deduplication

auth_utils cookies use secure=True + samesite='none' (correct for the preview proxy), but there is no refresh endpoint: once the 1-day access token expires the refresh_token cookie is unusable and the user is silently logged out
No rate limiting on /api/ai/* endpoints — each call hits the paid LLM provider with unbounded frequency

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all flows work; 2 mobile layout defects + minor testability/localization gaps)

Admin-created question 'TEST_UI вопрос 2+2?' was deleted after the test (question count back to 72).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/ (conftest.py + backend_test.py); pytest.ini runs -n 2 --dist loadscope, so keep per-class sequential state. Verified working end-to-end: auth cookies+Bearer, onboarding, 6 subjects with mastery, diagnostic (10q, answers stripped), study plan generate/patch, practice adaptive (difficulty badge changes Лёгкий->Средний->Сложный), mistakes create/resolve/retry, real Claude answers (no fallback) on /api/ai/chat, /api/ai/explain and topic-ai-explain-btn, dashboard/statistics real aggregates, mock exam 12q one-question-at-a-time UI with mock-submit-btn only on the last question, profile persistence after re-login, admin CRUD + student 403 + 'Доступ запрещён' guard on /app/admin, cross-user 404 isolation. Re-verify after fixes: mobile overflow on /app and /app/tutor (measure document.documentElement.scrollWidth - window.innerWidth at 390px, expected 0), dashboard tasks_completed after a diagnostic-only account, and login lockout.
rca_of_the_issue: Mobile overflow: grid items have min-width:auto by default, so the long task rows on Dashboard and the horizontally scrollable quick-action chip row inside the Tutor chat card force their grid track wider than the 390px viewport; the AppLayout main has min-w-0 but the page-level grid children do not. Stats gap: /api/diagnostics/{id}/answer stores answers only inside the diagnostics document and never inserts into question_attempts, while dashboard/statistics compute tasks_completed, accuracy and progress_over_time exclusively from question_attempts.
